verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes assembly-package acceptance conditions requiring LCSC identifiers in the BOM and documentation accounting for the listed resistors and jumpers.
This is the first concrete package-completeness failure: required assembly part numbers are missing and several included components are not accounted for in the specification.
The client explicitly postpones the BOM update until review of the schematic and PCB is complete.
After completing the design review, the client again requests completion and delivery of the latest BOM.
The client expands the power-board production artifact acceptance condition to include the BOM and every required manufacturing export; no prior attribute becomes obsolete.
This is the first target-specific completion claim that the power-board archive contains every required production file.
